title: RNA Guild Kit: card flavor text

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: A figure of Azorius law who says she serves only justice and, through it, all of Ravnica.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane whose guilds the flavor texts describe.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild of law on Ravnica, whose law is strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: A speaker who describes peace as gentle yet unstoppable.

entities.name: Mirela
entities.description: An Azorius hussar who was rescued by a roc.

entities.name: Barvisa
entities.description: A courtroom scribe.

entities.name: Thorpe
entities.description: A street urchin.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: An Orzhov scion who threatens to pursue betrayers even as ghosts, and who disparages the Gruul.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A guild of Ravnica that collects debts and contracts other guilds.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The guild of Ravnica devoted to Rakdos, known for violent shows and festivals.

entities.name: Tree of Weeping
entities.description: A tree in a township square where Rakdos cultists hanged a woman, whose ghost now stands vigil there.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A speaker who scorns innocence as a deficiency.

entities.name: The Cozen
entities.description: An Orzhov assassin.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: A speaker who senses only an empty sense of duty in Orzhov angels.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A killer with a rising bounty on her head who inspires imitators.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon lord of the Cult of Rakdos, whose stirring from slumber began everyone else's nightmare.

entities.name: Juri
entities.description: The proprietor of the Juri Revue.

entities.name: Juri Revue
entities.description: An establishment run by Juri.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild of Ravnica that confiscates weapons.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: The leader followed by the Gruul, whose only orders are 'Crush them!' and 'We eat!'

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The wild guild of Ravnica that seeks to destroy the city and punish the civilized.

entities.name: Kroshkar
entities.description: A Gruul shaman.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The guild of Ravnica that breeds krasis experiments and sells biological commodities.

entities.name: Mandor
entities.description: A Selesnya ranger.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A guild of Ravnica.

entities.name: Narbulg Nine Fingers
entities.description: A speaker commenting on a doomed soul.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: A Gruul speaker who foresees the city perishing under the boar-god.

entities.name: the boar-god
entities.description: A Gruul deity who will crush the city's last bricks into dust.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A guild contracted by the Orzhov to animate slum districts.

entities.name: Trigori
entities.description: An Azorius senator.

entities.name: Gurley
entities.description: The first to domesticate a Zhur-Taa swine, survived by his widow.

entities.name: Speaker Trifon
entities.description: A Simic speaker who merges life essences.

entities.name: Milana
entities.description: An Orzhov prelate who paid the Simic for a capability.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: A Simic figure who designs creatures able to choose their own evolution.

entities.name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
entities.description: A Simic who once lived primitively and has been transformed.

events.summary: Rakdos cultists hanged a woman for sport; her ghost now stands vigil at the Tree of Weeping.
events.quote: Rakdos cultists hanged her for sport in the township square.

events.summary: The bounty on Massacre Girl rose, and imitators multiplied.
events.quote: As the bounty on Massacre Girl rose, so did the number of imitators.

events.summary: Lord Rakdos stirred from his slumber, beginning everyone else's nightmare.
events.quote: When Lord Rakdos stirred from his slumber, everyone else's nightmare began.

events.summary: Mirela is rescued by a roc.
events.quote: I never thought I'd be so glad to see two tons of beak and claws bearing down on me at the speed of an arrow.

events.summary: The Orzhov contract the Izzet to animate slums and banish them; the Gruul send them back for vengeance.
events.quote: The Orzhov contract the Izzet to animate slum districts and banish them to the wastes.

events.summary: Gurley became the first to domesticate a Zhur-Taa swine, apparently dying in the process.
events.quote: Gurley was the first to domesticate one, though his widow didn't take much solace in that accomplishment.

relations.quote: It's easy to see why those Gruul dirtbags follow him
The Orzhov contract the Izzet to animate slum districts and banish them to the wastes.

relations.note: send animated slums back for vengeance
relations.quote: The Gruul adopt them and send them back to the city for vengeance.
I serve only justice. But through that duty, I serve all of Ravnica.
